Employment Notification No.: NIPER-HJP/PE/ICMR/2026-27/AEMG-1                                                       Date: 12/11/2026 
 
Recruitment of Project Technical Support -III staff (purely on a temporary basis) 
 
The National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER) Hajipur is an autonomous institution of 
national importance, established under the aegis of the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and 
Fertilizers, Govt. of India, under the NIPER Act,  1998. It is recognized as a center of excellence in biological 
therapeutics, is dedicated to offering master's and doctoral degrees through research and development in 
pharmaceutical sciences, and is conceived to provide leadership in pharmaceutical sciences and other related areas. 
Applications are invited from eligible and suitable Indian Nationals for the following one post on contractual basis 
as per the requirement for ICMR -sponsored project “Hybrid Nanoarchitectures for Precision Non -Small Cell 
Lung Cancer Therapy: Surface -Functionalized Lipid –Polymer Systems for Targeted Drug Delivery with 
Integrated Preclinical and Multi -Omics Validation”  (Project ID:  IIRPSG(AN) -I-2026-01-00277) under Dr. 
Vinod L. Gaikwad (Principal Investigator)”.

     ‘OR’ 
• Post graduate (PG) degree in the Life/Health sciences field without professional

Desirable qualifications/experience and nature of work:  
• Preference will be given to c andidates with Pharmacy / Pharmaceutical Sciences / 
[Pharmaceutics / Pharmacology / Pharmaceutical Analysis / Biotechnology / Life 
Sciences] background. 
• Experience in developing lipidic and polymeric nanocarriers, surface conjugation, 
physicochemical and solid-state characterization. 
• Preference will be given to candidates with additional experience in in-silico studies, cell 
culture assays (preferably cancer cells), in-vivo animal experiments (preferably tumour-
bearing models), multi-omics data generation and interpretation. 
• Previous involvement in academic research projects and/or publications. 
• The aforementioned qualification(s) must be from a recognized

responsible for the overall coordination and conduct of project activities, including 
maintenance of documentation (lab notebooks and records), and data analysis and report 
writing along with the study team. 
How to apply • Interested candidates may submit their CV with cover letter, along with scanned

given for attending the interview.

Hajipur in the Pharmaceutics department subject to the fulfilment of eligibility criteria 
and applicable clauses/norms defined under NIPER ordinance and NIPER -JEE at the 
time of admission. 
• For any further information/clarifications, the applicants may contact the principal 
investigator (drvinodg.niper@gmail.com) by email.
